summary: Frontend + integration testing for iteration 8: (1) country-privacy changed from HIDE to BLUR, and (2) bug fix for STATS 'backend unreachable' caused by desynced admin password. All 29 assertion checks across 6 scenarios passed. Backend endpoints /api/visits/stats (200 with correct X-Admin-Pass header, 401 without) confirmed via curl. UI blur behavior, non-explicit content readability, STATS tab loading, password-desync fix (no localStorage save on network error), and stats-401 friendly message all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.js loadStats() does not clear #statsErr.textContent when hiding it — stale error text remains in the DOM (harmless because display:none, but could confuse next testers/inspectors). Consider setting err.textContent='' when hiding.

restrictSensitive() only strips <option> nodes matching /in person/i. If admin later adds another IRL-tell string (e.g. 'IRL meet', 'meet up'), it will leak through booking dropdowns. Consider centralizing the sensitive-tell regex.

enforceGeoBlock() catches ALL errors silently (empty catch) — if ipapi.co is blocked/rate-limited the site silently behaves as unrestricted. Acceptable failure-open behavior for privacy-of-inconvenience but should be an intentional documented choice.
changePassword() correctly no longer persists on network error (fixed). Also handles 401 (backend rejected current password) via showToast without persist — good.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 requested scenarios verified end-to-end. (1) NORMAL visitor: body has no geo-blur class, all 6 [data-restrict] elements have filter:none, banner display:none. (2) BLUR (window.restrictSensitive()): body.geo-blur added, all sensitive selectors (#travel .location, #travel .travel-list, #travel .availability, #travel a[data-restrict], #booking [data-restrict], and the In-Person experience card) get computed filter 'blur(7px)'; all in-person <option> nodes are removed; banner [data-testid=geo-blur-banner] display:flex reading 'Some content is blurred for privacy in your region'. (3) NON-EXPLICIT readable under blur: #travel .lead filter:none, Findom card filter:none, hero h1 filter:none, nav a[href='#travel'] present + visible + filter:none. (4) STATS tab: login via Ctrl+Shift+K → #adminPassInput=candice2026 → Enter → panel gets .show → click .admin-tab[data-tab='stats'] → #statsErr display:none, statToday/statWeek/statAll all show a number (observed '27'), #countryStats innerHTML populated (317 chars). (5) PASSWORD DESYNC FIX: monkeypatch fetch to reject any /api/admin/password request → click .admin-section[data-section='settings'] SAVE PASSWORD button after filling #newPass='testpass9' → localStorage 'candice_admin_pass' remained null (NOT set to testpass9) and #adminToast text is exactly 'Backend unreachable — password unchanged'. (6) STATS 401: monkeypatch fetch so /api/visits/stats returns Response 401 → switch to STATS tab → #statsErr display:block with text "Couldn't load stats — password doesn't match the server. Re-set it in Settings." (NOT 'unreachable'). NOTE for next agent: (a) admin.js is wrapped in an IIFE — only window.restrictSensitive and window.enforceGeoBlock are exposed. loadStats/changePassword must be triggered via the tab/button UI, not window.*. (b) Login password input id is #adminPassInput (not #adminPass or 'input[type=password]'). (c) #statsErr keeps stale textContent when hidden — always check computed display in addition to text.
rca of the issue: Original bug: admin's changePassword() unconditionally saved the new password to localStorage even if the backend response was not confirmed 200. If the backend request threw or returned non-OK, the browser's saved password diverged from the backend's ADMIN_UPLOAD_PASS. Every subsequent authenticated call (X-Admin-Pass header) received 401, and loadStats surfaced that as 'backend unreachable', masking the real cause. Fix (verified): changePassword() now only writes localStorage on r.ok, shows 'Backend rejected current password' on 401, 'Server error' on other non-OK, and 'Backend unreachable — password unchanged' on network exception. loadStats() now distinguishes 401 → 'password doesn't match the server. Re-set it in Settings.' from network error → 'backend unreachable'. Both branches confirmed working via fetch monkeypatching.
